name: Zetrix TradeTrust
description: TradeTrust document issuance and eBL operations on Zetrix L2.

network.title: Network
network.description: Resolves the core-engine base URL automatically. Ignored if baseUrl is set. Defaults to z2-testnet.

baseUrl.title: core-engine base URL (optional -- overrides network if set)

callerId.title: HMAC caller id (optional)
callerId.description: Omit alongside hmacSecret to install with only health_check/verify_credential/verify_ebl/list_document_types -- no server-side account needed.

hmacSecret.title: HMAC secret (optional)
hmacSecret.description: Omit alongside callerId to install with only health_check/verify_credential/verify_ebl/list_document_types -- no server-side account needed.
